raw_response: {"diagnosis": "All 362 batch 14 rows have source_tz='UTC', but their txn_ts is stored in UTC while the other batches are Chicago local time. The fix converts only source_tz='UTC' rows in silver_transactions, leaving the rest unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN (CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
